stepProtocol.company: Company member's frozen message in the Role chat (company-side LLM). Expected: one contact_talent send_to_agent to the candidate's Harper; no draft, direct email or delivery schedule.
stepProtocol.candidate-agent: Career background receiver processes the queued company-agent message (replaces v3 deliver-candidate email capture). The candidate's Harper decides whether and how to tell the candidate (contact_user / chat).
stepProtocol.candidate: Candidate's frozen reply in Career chat. Expected: one contact_company to the company's agent in the existing correspondence (or recommendationId / legacy recommendation: connection), delivered inline with a company receiver job.
stepProtocol.candidate-first: Candidate starts in Career chat before any company question (UCT03).
stepProtocol.event: Company receiver (service principal) handles the incoming candidate-agent message: tells the team via contact_user when useful; can reply to the candidate's agent; cannot move stages or Roles.
stepProtocol.company-confirm: A team member confirms in the Role chat after the event (owner decision B). Only now may the company-side LLM move or reopen.
